title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Psalms 12: flattering lips and boasting tongues, and Yahweh's flawless words like refined silver.

questions.text: Why does the psalmist cry out for help at the start?
questions.explanation: Psalms 12:1 says, "Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases."

questions.text: What does everyone do to his neighbor?
questions.explanation: Psalms 12:2 says everyone lies to his neighbor.

questions.text: With what kind of heart do they speak?
questions.explanation: Psalms 12:2 says they speak with flattering lips and with a double heart.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask Yahweh to cut off?
questions.explanation: Psalms 12:3 asks Yahweh to cut off all flattering lips and the tongue that boasts.

questions.text: What do the boasters say about their lips?
questions.explanation: Psalms 12:4 quotes them: "Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?"

questions.text: Because of what does Yahweh say he will now arise?
questions.explanation: Psalms 12:5 says Yahweh will arise because of the oppression of the weak and the groaning of the needy.

answers.text: The oppression of the weak and the groaning of the needy
The prayers of the priests in the sanctuary
The pride of the kings of the earth
The sins of the fathers and their sons

questions.text: To what are Yahweh's words compared?
questions.explanation: Psalms 12:6 says Yahweh's words are flawless, as silver refined in a clay furnace.

answers.text: Gold brought from a distant land
Silver refined in a clay furnace

questions.text: How many times is the silver purified in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Psalms 12:6 says the silver is purified seven times.

questions.text: From what will Yahweh preserve them forever?
questions.explanation: Psalms 12:7 says, "You will preserve them from this generation forever."

questions.text: When do the wicked walk on every side?
questions.explanation: Psalms 12:8 says the wicked walk on every side when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.

answers.text: When what is vile is exalted
